_how_to_use: Deliberate deviations from a capability's contract, as data, so adding or
annotating a model never means editing tests/test_providers.py.
Key:   '<capability>:<provider id>' exactly as the test ids show it
(e.g. 'pose:rtmw'), or '<capability>:*' for every provider of one
'skip':   reason   - don't test this model at all (not installed here,
needs hardware you don't have, known broken upstream)
'exempt': reason   - run the contract tests but not the fixture-behaviour
'xfail':  reason   - expect failure, report it as xfail instead of red
'tests':  {test name: reason}  - narrow xfail/skip/exempt to one test,
Delete an entry and the model is held to the full contract again.

detect.barcodes:builtin.exempt: stub handle (always []); modules/barcodes/scan.py runs its own CV search, tested in modules/barcodes/tests
